name: viridis-agent-reliability
description: Evidence-bounded reliability checks for MCP and A2A services

interface.shortDescription: Check whether an MCP or A2A service is safe and reliable to buy.
interface.longDescription: Runs a bounded, read-only reliability check across discovery, protocol compatibility, identity, authority, payment, delivery evidence, and retention readiness. It distinguishes observed evidence from unknowns and never treats listings or technical health as commercial proof.
defaultPrompt: Run a reliability check on this agent endpoint.
Audit this MCP server before I connect it.
Check this A2A Agent Card and authority boundary.
